content:
Hi,

Is there way to run Lean LSP in offline mode?
It seems there is some VPN filter.
The Lean LSP per se does not perform online interactions, other components of lean like elan or lake might try to download toolchains or build caches.

Henrik Böving said:

The Lean LSP per se does not perform online interactions, other components of lean like elan or lake might try to download toolchains or build caches.

Yes, lake needs traffic, but some how their behaviors diverge, because emacs with lean4-mode on attempt to open a file in lean project freezes forever, meanwhile lake build with hot cache quits instantly.
